description: Resolution log for every flag raised in ir1_agent_flags.json. All 4 flags were resolved by a targeted patch to implementation_execution_plan.json (single batched dispatch, 2026-09-17), independently re-verified by consensus-agent's IR.5 pass.

resolutions.resolution: Added an operational definition of 'locatable' to dev_prompt and qa_prompt: a fact is locatable if its item_id/episode_id resolves to its primary key (tenant_id, session_id, seq) via a direct B-tree PK lookup, never a full-zone BRIN scan -- grounded in HLD Section 3.3/12D.

Corrected AC-006 and all context labels in dev_prompt/qa_prompt/review_prompt from 'zones 2-5, 7, 8' to the HLD-accurate 'zones 2/3/4/5/8; Zone 7 never indexed', per HLD Section 3.7/3.10 Data Ownership Map. ar1_assignments.json checked -- already correct, no change needed there.
resolutions.verified_by: consensus-agent (IR.5 retry 2, cross-checked against HLD 3.10's PROJECTS INTO lines)

resolutions.resolution: Added new AC-009-R1-1 to dev_prompt and qa_prompt requiring every /context/assemble response (success or degraded) to include a unique assembly_id and trace_id, per HLD's R-1 (repudiation) mitigation. Flagged as correctness/observability, not security-gated (no P1 change).

Added must-not-deviate line to dev_prompt and review_prompt: 'UserAffinity must NEVER function as a tenant-isolation mechanism (per ADR-013/threat I-2) -- tenant scoping is enforced structurally upstream (physical partition), UserAffinity is purely a within-tenant relevance signal.'
resolutions.verified_by: consensus-agent (IR.5 retry 2, cross-checked against HLD ADR-013 and threat I-2)

resolutions.resolution: Reworded spike exit criterion #1 and its INVEST.small field in backlog_draft.json, and the matching text in implementation_execution_plan.json's dev_prompt, from 'the version ADR-007 originally evaluated' (a fact ADR-007 does not actually contain) to 'the earliest Qdrant version compatible with ADR-007's approved architecture', with an explicit note that this is a fresh research finding, not a citable ADR-007 fact. Removes the self-contradicting instruction (cite verbatim + never fabricate a fact the source doesn't contain).
resolutions.verified_by: direct re-read of HLD.md's ADR-007 confirming no version number appears anywhere in it

resolutions.raised_by: product-manager-agent, solution-architect, scrum-master-agent (2026-09-19 supplemental review -- same underlying gap independently raised by 3 reviewers)
resolutions.resolution: Added 'DASH-STORY-011' to DASH-STORY-007's depends_on array and to dependency_graph.DASH-STORY-007 in backlog_draft.json, and to the matching dependency_integrity_check.edges.DASH-STORY-007 array in ar1_assignments.json. Updated ar1_assignments.json's AR1-011 logging_note to state this is now a real DAG edge, not just prose precedence. The recommendation-must-land-before-adapter-code constraint is now enforceable by AR.2's mechanical DAG-based execution grouping, not left to narrative discipline alone.
resolutions.verified_by: re-ran docs/orchestration/schemas/validate_handoff.py against backlog-draft.schema.json -- cycle_detection still PASS after the new edge

story_011_supplemental_pass.detail: DASH-STORY-011 (Jira DSHN-54) was absent from implementation_execution_plan.json's 30-prompt set at the time ir1_agent_flags.json was originally produced (2026-09-17). A genuine supplemental IR.1-equivalent review (all 4 personas, real agent.md + mandatory skills loaded) was dispatched 2026-09-19, found 2 real, distinct flags (both above, both RESOLVED), and is reflected in ir1_agent_flags.json's verdict_per_story entries for DASH-STORY-011 (replacing the earlier NOT_REVIEWED_MISSING_FROM_ORIGINAL_IR1_PASS placeholder). See ir5_alignment_verdict.json's story_011_supplemental_verdict for the resulting gate outcome.

disclosed_non_blocking_notes: DASH-STORY-007: BA noted the P1 gate is explicitly marked 'conditional' pending user acceptance of the AC-014 scope-extension deviation -- disclosed open decision, not an unresolved flag.
DASH-STORY-003: SA noted a minor, non-blocking omission of HLD Section 3.3's keyset-only/no-offset prohibition -- judged non-blocking, not patched.
